entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. U. Choudhury, learned Legal Aid Counsel for the applicant/appellant.

Also heard Mr. B.
Sarma, learned Addl. P.P., Assam appearing on behalf of the State respondent.
This interlocutory application is filed under Section 430(2) of the BNSS, for suspension of sentence and releasing the accused on bail, against the judgment dated 28.03.2025 and order of sentence dated 03.04.2025, passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Cachar at Silchar in Sessions Case No.139/2024, convicting the applicant/appellant under Section 341/376 of the IPC and sentenced him to undergo R.I. for 10 years and to pay a fine of Rs. 5,000/-, with default stipulation under Section 376 of the IPC and S.I. for one month under Section 341 of the IPC .
Issue notice.
List the matter immediately after receipt of the TCR along with the connected Criminal Appeal.
Mr. Sarma, the learned Addl. P.P., Assam submitted that they will file their objection immediately after receipt of the TCR.
